title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows, optimize caches and action versions
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: our monolithic CI workflow has grown slow and brittle (long queue times, noisy caches, coupled lint/test/release steps). This PR splits the monorepo CI into focused workflows (lint, unit-test, integration-test, release) and consolidates shared logic into a small set of referenced reusable workflows to improve developer feedback loops and reduce wasted runner time. Changes: 1) Split .github/workflows/ci.yml into: .github/workflows/lint.yml, test.yml, integration.yml, release.yml. 2) Introduced .github/workflows/workflow-templates/cache.yml and tooling for consistent caching keys across repos. 3) Upgraded pinned GitHub Actions to community-recommended stable tags (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4) and added explanatory comments for pin choices. 4) Added smarter cache keys that include lockfile/node-version/sha for workspace package.json changes to avoid cache poisoning. 5) Test matrix reduced to active Node.js versions (18, 20) with optional 16 compat job on schedule only. 6) Release workflow now uses a dedicated dry-run job and separate publish job gated by manual approval for production releases. 7) Small tuning: reduced default concurrent jobs for public forks to limit CI spend, moved large e2e jobs to a separate perf-canary trigger. Checklist: - [x] Split workflows and wire reusable templates - [x] Verify all actions versions pinned - [x] Implement deterministic cache keys - [x] Update internal docs (CONTRIBUTING.md CI section) - [x] Run full CI and fix failing flakey integration tests - [x] Handful of follow-ups filed for further test sharding (ENG-4990). Notes: kept the description concise but included links to internal Linear tasks and the canary plan. Rolling deployment: none required. Backwards compatibility: none of the changes affect runtime code; only CI.
commits: chore(ci): split workflows into lint/test/integration/release; feat(ci): add reusable cache template and key strategy; ci: pin actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-node@v4; fix(tests): stabilize integration/flaky-db-tests by adding retry+teardown; docs: update CONTRIBUTING.md CI section; chore(ci): reduce default concurrency for forks
review_thread:
Diego Morales (reviewer): Please split unit and integration jobs so unit runs are fast for PR feedback. Also add a short-lived cache key for node_modules that includes package-lock.json sha.

Aisha (author): Thanks — split done, caching strategy moved to workflow-templates/cache.yml; added package-lock sha and node-version to key.

Priya Narang (reviewer): The pinned actions look good; can you justify actions/checkout@v4 vs @v3 for forks? We observed differences previously.

Aisha (author): v4 fixes several OOM regressions on large monorepos and has improved sparse-checkout support; added comment with link to GH issue and rollback plan.

Ethan Li (reviewer): Integration flake still shows in one run — add retry/backoff or ensure teardown cleans DB.

Aisha (author): Added retry(3) helper around flaky integration test and added explicit teardown script; re-ran CI and integration job passed.

Diego Morales: approved after fixes. Priya: approved. Ethan: approved with minor nits (addressed).
ci_checks_summary: Initial CI run (2026-01-15): lint: pass; unit-tests: pass; integration-tests: fail (flaky DB cleanup); release-dry-run: skipped (manual trigger); build: pass. Follow-up run after fixes (2026-01-20): lint: pass; unit-tests: pass; integration-tests: pass (retries tolerated); build: pass; release-dry-run: pass. Overall: green. Actions pinned and cache warmed. Observed CI median runtime for PRs reduced ~30% in our sample runs.
merge_summary: Merged via squash merge by Ethan Li on 2026-01-22. Squash commit title: 'refactor(ci): split workflows, pin actions, and improve cache hygiene' Commit message summarizes work and references ENG-4821 and ENG-4990 for follow-ups. No runtime code changes included. Continuous delivery: release workflow added a manual gate; no automatic production publishes were performed as part of this merge.
release_notes: CI: Split monolithic CI into targeted workflows (lint, unit, integration, release). Pinned major GitHub Actions versions, consolidated cache logic, and improved cache keys. Faster PR feedback loop and reduced CI spend. Follow-ups: further test sharding and perf-canary for e2e jobs (ENG-4990).
